summary.big_en: Say what is in the classroom with There is and There are.

grammar.title: There is / There are
grammar.when: Use There is and There are to say what is in a place.
grammar.form: There is + one thing · There are + more than one thing

examples.why: one thing, so There is
more than one, so There are

examples.en: There is a world map on the wall.
examples.why: one map, so There is

grammar.watch: Count the thing first, then choose is or are.

words.title: Classroom objects and days of the week

items.def: Pages with words and pictures joined together.
items.example: When I open up a book, each page whispers, 'Look!'
items.example_vi: Khi em mở một quyển sách, mỗi trang lại thì thầm: 'Nhìn kìa!'

items.def: A drawing that shows where places are.
items.example: We look at the map to find our country.
items.example_vi: Chúng em nhìn bản đồ để tìm nước mình.

items.def: A chart that shows the days and months of the year.
items.example: There is a world map and a calendar on the wall.
items.example_vi: Trên tường có một tấm bản đồ thế giới và một tờ lịch.

items.def: A thing on the wall that shows the time.
items.example: Point to the clock, please!
items.example_vi: Hãy chỉ vào cái đồng hồ nào!

items.def: A small flat computer you touch with your finger.
items.example: There is a tablet on the teacher's desk.
items.example_vi: Có một chiếc máy tính bảng trên bàn cô giáo.

items.def: The first day of the school week.
items.example: On Monday the children sing.
items.example_vi: Vào thứ Hai các bạn hát.

items.def: The day after Monday.
items.example: What does Marco do on Tuesday?
items.example_vi: Thứ Ba Marco làm gì?

items.def: The day after Tuesday.
items.example: We read books on Wednesday.
items.example_vi: Thứ Tư chúng em đọc sách.

items.def: The day after Wednesday.
items.example: Marco paints on Thursday.
items.example_vi: Thứ Năm Marco vẽ tranh.

items.def: The last day of the school week.
items.example: On Friday we play games.
items.example_vi: Thứ Sáu chúng em chơi trò chơi.

items.def: The day after Friday, when there is no school.
items.example: I stay at home on Saturday.
items.example_vi: Thứ Bảy em ở nhà.

items.def: The day after Saturday, when there is no school.
items.example: On Sunday my family goes to the park.
items.example_vi: Chủ nhật gia đình em đi công viên.

summary.big_en: Say what one person does with an -s on the verb. Some books tell stories and some give real information.

grammar.title: Present simple: he, she and it take -s
grammar.when: Use the present simple to say what someone does again and again, such as on a certain day of the week.
grammar.form: I / you / we / they + verb · he / she / it + verb + s

examples.why: the children = they, so no -s
Marco = he, so the verb takes -s
they, so no -s
he, so the verb takes -s

grammar.watch: Ask yourself: one person, or more than one?

items.def: A person or animal in a story.
items.example: The people or animals in a story are called characters.
items.example_vi: Người hoặc con vật trong một câu chuyện được gọi là nhân vật.

items.def: Not real, only in someone's imagination.
items.example: Stories are not real; they are make-believe.
items.example_vi: Truyện không có thật; đó là chuyện tưởng tượng.

items.def: Facts that are true and that you can learn from.
items.example: Some books give real information.
items.example_vi: Có những quyển sách cho thông tin có thật.

phrases.title: Talking about the time and the day

lines: What does Marco do on Tuesday?

summary.big_en: Every book has a title and an author. The contents page tells you what is inside.

items.def: The name of a book or story.
items.example: What is the title of the book?
items.example_vi: Tên quyển sách này là gì?

items.def: The writer of a book.
items.example: Who is the author of the book?
items.example_vi: Ai là tác giả của quyển sách?

groups.when: Finding the name and the writer
lines: What is the title of the book?
Who is the author of the book?
In which chapter can you find this?
Which page will you look at?

readings.title: Schools Around the World
readings.about: A book about schools in different countries, with four chapters: school uniforms, first day of school, art class and lunchtime. The contents page shows which page each chapter starts on.

summary.big_en: Add 's to a name to say who something belongs to.

grammar.title: Saying who something belongs to
grammar.when: Use 's after a person's name to show the thing is theirs.
grammar.form: name + 's + thing · my / your / his / her + thing

examples.why: name + 's shows the backpack belongs to Lucy
same pattern with a different name
my comes before the thing

grammar.watch: The 's goes on the owner, not on the thing.

grammar.title: Saying it short: yours, mine, one
grammar.when: Use mine and yours when you do not want to say the thing again.
grammar.form: my backpack = mine · your backpack = yours · the red backpack = the red one

examples.en: Is this your backpack? = Is it yours?
examples.why: yours replaces your backpack

examples.en: Yes, it's my backpack. = Yes, it's mine.
examples.why: mine replaces my backpack
one replaces the thing you both know about

items.def: A round thing you kick, throw or catch.
items.example: He has a ball in his backpack.
items.example_vi: Bạn ấy có một quả bóng trong ba lô.

items.def: A rope you jump over again and again.
items.example: There is a skipping rope in Jill's backpack.
items.example_vi: Trong ba lô của Jill có một sợi dây nhảy.

items.def: A small thing you use to talk to someone far away.
items.example: Her phone is in the yellow backpack.
items.example_vi: Điện thoại của bạn ấy ở trong cái ba lô vàng.

items.def: A warm top you pull over your head.
items.example: She has a yellow jumper.
items.example_vi: Bạn ấy có một chiếc áo len màu vàng.

items.def: A thin stick you write and draw with.
items.example: There is a pencil in my lunchbox.
items.example_vi: Có một cái bút chì trong hộp cơm của em.

items.def: A box you carry your lunch in.
items.example: She has a lunchbox in her backpack.
items.example_vi: Bạn ấy có một hộp cơm trưa trong ba lô.

items.def: A small book of empty pages for writing in.
items.example: He has a notebook and a pencil.
items.example_vi: Bạn ấy có một quyển vở và một cái bút chì.

items.def: Dark glasses you wear when the sun is bright.
items.example: He wears sunglasses on the field trip.
items.example_vi: Bạn ấy đeo kính râm khi đi dã ngoại.

items.def: Something you wear on your head.
items.example: He has a hat and two keys.
items.example_vi: Bạn ấy có một cái mũ và hai chiếc chìa khoá.

items.def: A small metal thing that opens a lock.
items.example: He has two keys.
items.example_vi: Bạn ấy có hai chiếc chìa khoá.

summary.big_en: A, E, I, O and U are vowels. Two letters together can make one new sound.

items.def: One of the five letters A, E, I, O and U.
items.example: A, E, I, O and U are vowels.
items.example_vi: A, E, I, O, U là các nguyên âm.

items.def: Any letter that is not a vowel.
items.example: Some letters are called consonants and some are called vowels.
items.example_vi: Có những chữ cái gọi là phụ âm và có những chữ gọi là nguyên âm.

items.def: A small animal with six legs, like an ant.
items.example: Insect starts with the short i sound.
items.example_vi: Từ insect bắt đầu bằng âm i ngắn.

items.def: A thing you hold over your head in the rain.
items.example: Umbrella starts with the short u sound.
items.example_vi: Từ umbrella bắt đầu bằng âm u ngắn.

items.def: The round thing a bird lays, which we can eat.
items.example: Egg starts with the short e sound.
items.example_vi: Từ egg bắt đầu bằng âm e ngắn.

items.def: A sea animal with eight arms.
items.example: Octopus starts with the short o sound.
items.example_vi: Từ octopus bắt đầu bằng âm o ngắn.

items.def: A round red or green fruit.
items.example: Apple starts with the short a sound.
items.example_vi: Từ apple bắt đầu bằng âm a ngắn.

items.def: A small furry animal many people keep at home.
items.example: The cat has the short a sound in the middle.
items.example_vi: Từ cat có âm a ngắn ở giữa.

items.def: To take hold of something moving through the air.
items.example: Catch ends with the tch letters.
items.example_vi: Từ catch kết thúc bằng cụm chữ tch.

items.def: To open or divide something with scissors or a knife.
items.example: Cut has the short u sound in the middle.
items.example_vi: Từ cut có âm u ngắn ở giữa.

items.def: The lesson where you work with numbers and shapes.
items.example: Maths ends with the th sound.
items.example_vi: Từ maths kết thúc bằng âm th.

items.def: A thin tool you write with, using ink.
items.example: How do you spell it? P-e-n.
items.example_vi: Từ đó đánh vần thế nào? P-e-n.

items.def: Long thin pieces of potato that are cooked in oil.
items.example: Chips begins with the ch sound.
items.example_vi: Từ chips bắt đầu bằng âm ch.

items.def: A big boat that carries people across the sea.
items.example: Ship begins with the sh sound.
items.example_vi: Từ ship bắt đầu bằng âm sh.

items.def: A place where you buy things.
items.example: Shop begins with the sh sound.
items.example_vi: Từ shop bắt đầu bằng âm sh.

items.def: A hard piece of stone.
items.example: Rock has the short o sound in the middle.
items.example_vi: Từ rock có âm o ngắn ở giữa.

items.def: Coming after the fourth one.
items.example: Fifth ends with the th sound.
items.example_vi: Từ fifth kết thúc bằng âm th.

sounds.title: The five short vowel sounds
sounds.focus: A, E, I, O and U are vowels; all the other letters are consonants.
sounds.note: Listen for the same short sound in the middle of a word: cat, pen, ship, rock, cut.

sounds.title: sh, ch, th and tch
sounds.focus: Two or three letters together make one new sound.
sounds.note: ch and tch make the same sound; tch comes after a short vowel.

summary.big_en: Write about yourself with I and my. Write about your class with we and our.

grammar.title: I and my, or we and our
grammar.when: Choose the words that match who is writing: one person, or a group.
grammar.form: one writer: I / my · a group of writers: we / our

examples.en: I am in the second grade.
examples.why: Fernando wrote his book by himself

examples.en: My teacher's name is Ms Cruz.
examples.why: my, because one person is writing

examples.en: We are in the second grade.
examples.why: a group is writing the chapter together
our, because the class shares the teacher

grammar.watch: Ask first: am I writing alone, or with my class?

lines: You take good care of your books and papers.
You use science materials carefully and safely.
You remember to do your homework.

readings.title: My school
readings.about: Fernando, a second-grade boy in Cebu in the Philippines, writes five short chapters about his school day: his school, his classroom, science class, break time and the end of the day.

summary.big_en: Name the people who live and work in your neighbourhood.

items.def: A person who lives near you.
items.example: There are neighbours helping neighbours in my neighbourhood.
items.example_vi: Có những người hàng xóm giúp đỡ nhau trong khu phố của em.

items.def: The streets around your home.
items.example: Come and meet the people in my neighbourhood.
items.example_vi: Hãy đến gặp những người trong khu phố của em.

items.def: The child of your aunt or uncle.
items.example: What is his cousin doing?
items.example_vi: Anh họ của bạn ấy đang làm gì?

items.def: Your father's father or your mother's father.
items.example: His sister and grandpa are helping too.
items.example_vi: Chị bạn ấy và ông cũng đang giúp.

items.def: A person whose job is to keep people safe.
items.example: What is the police officer doing?
items.example_vi: Chú cảnh sát đang làm gì?

items.def: A person whose job is to look after people who are ill.
items.example: Who is the nurse helping?
items.example_vi: Cô y tá đang giúp ai?

items.def: A person whose job is to find out news and tell people about it.
items.example: The reporter is writing about our street.
items.example_vi: Cô phóng viên đang viết về con phố của chúng em.

items.def: A person whose job is to drive a bus.
items.example: The bus driver stops for the children.
items.example_vi: Bác tài xế xe buýt dừng lại cho các bạn nhỏ.

items.def: A person whose job is to clean windows.
items.example: The window cleaner works high above the street.
items.example_vi: Chú lau kính làm việc trên cao phía trên con phố.

phrases.title: Asking about people in a picture

lines: What is the police officer doing?
She is helping an old man.

readings.title: My neighbourhood (poem)
readings.about: A child invites you to meet the neighbours on the streets around their home — grandmas, grandpas, cousins, mums, dads, girls and boys.

summary.big_en: Say what a worker does and what special clothes keep them safe.

items.def: A person whose job is to put out fires.
items.example: Firefighters have important jobs. They put out fires.
items.example_vi: Lính cứu hoả có công việc quan trọng. Họ dập lửa.

items.def: To save someone from danger.
items.example: They rescue people who are inside burning buildings.
items.example_vi: Họ cứu những người đang ở trong toà nhà cháy.

items.def: A hard hat that protects your head.
items.example: If something falls on a firefighter's head, the helmet keeps them safe.
items.example_vi: Nếu có vật rơi trúng đầu, chiếc mũ bảo hộ giữ cho lính cứu hoả an toàn.

items.def: A cover for your face.
items.example: The mask lets the firefighter breathe fresh air.
items.example_vi: Chiếc mặt nạ giúp lính cứu hoả thở được không khí sạch.

items.def: Covers for your hands.
items.example: Firefighters can touch hot things with their gloves.
items.example_vi: Nhờ găng tay, lính cứu hoả có thể chạm vào vật nóng.

items.def: Strong shoes that cover your feet and ankles.
items.example: They wear heavy boots on their feet.
items.example_vi: Họ đi ủng nặng ở chân.

items.def: To ask someone questions to find out about them.
items.example: Josef is interviewing a firefighter.
items.example_vi: Josef đang phỏng vấn một lính cứu hoả.

items.def: A piece of writing that tells people what you found out.
items.example: Josef writes a report about Miss Dilov and her job.
items.example_vi: Josef viết một bài tường thuật về cô Dilov và công việc của cô.

items.def: The building where firefighters work.
items.example: She works at the fire station.
items.example_vi: Cô ấy làm việc ở trạm cứu hoả.

lines: I work at the fire station.

readings.title: Firefighters
readings.about: Firefighters put out fires and rescue people from burning buildings. The text names each piece of their kit — boots, jacket, helmet, mask, air pack and gloves — and says how each one keeps them safe.

summary.big_en: Say where you live, from your floor to your continent.

grammar.title: Ordinal numbers for floors
grammar.when: Use ordinal numbers to say which floor of a building something is on.
grammar.form: first, second, third, fourth … tenth, twelfth, fourteenth

examples.en: My family lives on the second floor.
examples.why: second, not two — it is the position

examples.en: Her grandparents live on the fourteenth floor.
examples.why: -teenth for 13th and 14th

examples.en: The first three are special: first, second, third.
examples.why: they do not end in -th

items.def: A home inside a bigger building.
items.example: I live in an apartment building.
items.example_vi: Em sống trong một toà chung cư.

items.def: One level of a building.
items.example: My family lives on the second floor.
items.example_vi: Gia đình em sống ở tầng hai.

items.def: A very big town.
items.example: I live in Mexico, in a city called Merida.
items.example_vi: Em sống ở Mexico, trong một thành phố tên là Merida.

items.def: The most important city of a country.
items.example: Mexico City is the capital of Mexico.
items.example_vi: Mexico City là thủ đô của Mexico.

items.def: One of the very large areas of land on Earth.
items.example: Mexico is in North America. North America is a continent.
items.example_vi: Mexico nằm ở Bắc Mỹ. Bắc Mỹ là một châu lục.

items.def: A drawing that shows where places are.
items.example: On the map, Merida is in square D-2.
items.example_vi: Trên bản đồ, Merida nằm ở ô D-2.

items.def: A small room that carries you up and down a tall building.
items.example: Silvia likes pressing the buttons in the lift.
items.example_vi: Silvia thích bấm nút trong thang máy.

items.def: A message you write and send to someone.
items.example: This is a letter from Silvia.
items.example_vi: Đây là một lá thư của Silvia.

readings.title: A letter from Silvia
readings.about: Silvia writes to an unknown friend. She gives her name and age, says she lives on the second floor of an apartment building in Merida, Mexico, and points out her city and her grandparents' city on a grid map.

summary.big_en: Use place words to say exactly where something is, and to give directions.

grammar.title: Prepositions of place
grammar.when: Use these words to say exactly where a thing is.
grammar.form: in · on · under · behind · in front of · next to · between · opposite

examples.why: in — inside something
under — below something

examples.en: It's between the bookshop and the sweet shop.
examples.why: between — one thing on each side

items.def: At the side of something.
items.example: It's next to the shoe shop.
items.example_vi: Nó ở ngay cạnh cửa hàng giày.

items.def: With one thing on each side.
items.example: It's between the bookshop and the sweet shop.
items.example_vi: Nó nằm giữa hiệu sách và cửa hàng kẹo.

items.def: On the other side, facing something.
items.example: It's opposite the gift shop.
items.example_vi: Nó ở đối diện cửa hàng quà tặng.

items.def: At the back of something.
items.example: Look behind the door.
items.example_vi: Hãy nhìn phía sau cánh cửa.

items.def: At the front of something.
items.example: Look in front of the crayons.
items.example_vi: Hãy nhìn phía trước hộp bút màu.

items.def: Below something.
items.example: Look under the teacher's chair.
items.example_vi: Hãy nhìn dưới ghế của cô giáo.

items.def: Forwards, without turning.
items.example: Put your finger on the red star and go straight ahead.
items.example_vi: Đặt ngón tay lên ngôi sao đỏ rồi đi thẳng.

items.def: To go to the right side.
items.example: At the end, turn right.
items.example_vi: Đến cuối đường thì rẽ phải.

items.def: A big building with many shops inside.
items.example: Look at the map of the shopping centre.
items.example_vi: Hãy nhìn bản đồ trung tâm mua sắm.

lines: Excuse me, where is the gift shop?
Go straight ahead and turn right.

groups.when: Describing a place with a clue
lines: It's between the bookshop and the sweet shop.

summary.big_en: The spellings -er, -ir, -or and -ur can all stand for the same sound.

points.t: Many job words are made by adding -er or -or to a verb: sing + er = singer, act + or = actor (p.38).
The spellings -er, -ir, -or and -ur can all stand for the same sound, so you cannot hear which one a word uses (p.39).

items.def: A person who sings.
items.example: I'm a singer. I sing.
items.example_vi: Em là ca sĩ. Em hát.

items.def: A person who teaches.
items.example: I'm a teacher. I teach.
items.example_vi: Em là giáo viên. Em dạy học.

items.def: A person who acts in plays and films.
items.example: I'm an actor. I act.
items.example_vi: Em là diễn viên. Em diễn.

items.def: A person who writes books.
items.example: I am a writer. I write books.
items.example_vi: Em là nhà văn. Em viết sách.

items.def: A person who works on a boat.
items.example: I am a sailor. I sail boats.
items.example_vi: Em là thuỷ thủ. Em lái thuyền.

items.def: A person who paints.
items.example: I am a painter. I paint pictures.
items.example_vi: Em là hoạ sĩ. Em vẽ tranh.

items.def: A person who bakes bread.
items.example: I am a baker. I bake bread.
items.example_vi: Em là thợ làm bánh. Em nướng bánh mì.

items.def: A person who watches birds.
items.example: I am a birdwatcher. I like to watch birds.
items.example_vi: Em là người ngắm chim. Em thích ngắm chim.

sounds.title: Vowels followed by r: -er, -ir, -or, -ur
sounds.focus: Four different spellings, one sound. In singer, bird, actor and nurse the letters er, ir, or and ur all say the same unstressed /ə/ sound, so you cannot hear which spelling a word has — you have to remember it. Many job words are made by adding -er or -or to a verb: sing + er, act + or.

summary.big_en: A poem about how many kids there are, and the prefix un-.

grammar.title: The prefix un-
grammar.when: Put un- in front of a word to make it mean the opposite.

examples.why: un- turns it into the opposite
same pattern

examples.en: happy → unhappy — another word for sad
examples.why: un- gives a word for sad

items.def: Many; a big number of.
items.example: There are a lot of kids living in my apartment building.
items.example_vi: Có rất nhiều bạn nhỏ sống trong toà chung cư của em.

items.def: A road in a town with houses along it.
items.example: There are a lot of apartment buildings on my street.
items.example_vi: Có rất nhiều toà chung cư trên phố nhà em.

items.def: A land with its own name and government.
items.example: And cities in this country, and a lot of countries in the world.
items.example_vi: Và các thành phố trong đất nước này, và rất nhiều đất nước trên thế giới.

items.def: The Earth and everyone on it.
items.example: We've got the whole world in our hands.
items.example_vi: Chúng ta có cả thế giới trong tay mình.

items.def: To think about something you are not sure of.
items.example: I wonder if somewhere there's a kid I've never met.
items.example_vi: Em tự hỏi liệu ở đâu đó có một bạn nhỏ em chưa từng gặp.

items.def: Not known to you.
items.example: Dear unknown friend, my name is Silvia.
items.example_vi: Gửi người bạn chưa quen, mình tên là Silvia.

items.def: Not friendly.
items.example: Do you think the girl is friendly or unfriendly?
items.example_vi: Em nghĩ bạn nữ ấy thân thiện hay không thân thiện?

items.def: Not happy; sad.
items.example: Do you think this poem is happy or unhappy?
items.example_vi: Em nghĩ bài thơ này vui hay buồn?

readings.title: A lot of kids, by Jeff Moss
readings.about: The poem widens out from a lot of kids in one apartment building to buildings, streets, cities and countries in the whole world, and ends with the girl wondering whether a kid she has never met might become her best friend.

flashcards.front_en: When do you say There is, and when There are?
flashcards.back_en: There is for one thing; There are for more than one.

flashcards.front_en: The children sing. What does Marco do?
flashcards.back_en: Marco sings. He, she and it add -s to the verb.

flashcards.front_en: How many days are there in a week?
flashcards.back_en: Seven: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday.

flashcards.front_en: Where do you look to find what is in a book?
flashcards.back_en: The contents page, at the beginning of the book.

flashcards.front_en: How do you show that the backpack belongs to Lucy?
flashcards.back_en: Add 's to her name: Lucy's backpack.

flashcards.front_en: Say 'my backpack' and 'your backpack' in one word each.
flashcards.back_en: Mine and yours.
A, E, I, O and U. All the other letters are consonants.

flashcards.front_en: Which letters make the sound at the end of catch?
flashcards.back_en: tch, which sounds the same as ch and comes after a short vowel.

flashcards.front_en: Writing alone or writing with your class — which words?
flashcards.back_en: Alone: I and my. With your class: we and our.
A small flat computer you touch with your finger.
flashcards.example_en: There is a tablet on the teacher's desk.
flashcards.example_vi: Có một chiếc máy tính bảng trên bàn cô giáo.

flashcards.back_en: A thing on the wall that shows the time.
flashcards.example_en: Point to the clock, please!
flashcards.example_vi: Hãy chỉ vào cái đồng hồ nào!

flashcards.back_en: A chart that shows the days and months of the year.
flashcards.example_en: There is a world map and a calendar on the wall.
flashcards.example_vi: Trên tường có một tấm bản đồ thế giới và một tờ lịch.

flashcards.back_en: A drawing that shows where places are.
flashcards.example_en: On the map, Merida is in square D-2.
flashcards.example_vi: Trên bản đồ, Merida nằm ở ô D-2.

flashcards.back_en: Pages with words and pictures joined together.
flashcards.example_en: When I open up a book, each page whispers, 'Look!'
flashcards.example_vi: Khi em mở một quyển sách, mỗi trang lại thì thầm: 'Nhìn kìa!'

flashcards.back_en: The first day of the school week.
flashcards.example_en: On Monday the children sing.
flashcards.example_vi: Vào thứ Hai các bạn hát.

flashcards.back_en: The day after Monday.
flashcards.example_en: What does Marco do on Tuesday?
flashcards.example_vi: Thứ Ba Marco làm gì?

flashcards.back_en: The day after Tuesday.
flashcards.example_en: We read books on Wednesday.
flashcards.example_vi: Thứ Tư chúng em đọc sách.

flashcards.back_en: The day after Wednesday.
flashcards.example_en: Marco paints on Thursday.
flashcards.example_vi: Thứ Năm Marco vẽ tranh.

flashcards.back_en: The last day of the school week.
flashcards.example_en: On Friday we play games.
flashcards.example_vi: Thứ Sáu chúng em chơi trò chơi.

flashcards.back_en: The day after Friday, when there is no school.
flashcards.example_en: I stay at home on Saturday.
flashcards.example_vi: Thứ Bảy em ở nhà.

flashcards.back_en: The day after Saturday, when there is no school.
flashcards.example_en: On Sunday my family goes to the park.
flashcards.example_vi: Chủ nhật gia đình em đi công viên.

flashcards.back_en: A person or animal in a story.
flashcards.example_en: The people or animals in a story are called characters.
flashcards.example_vi: Người hoặc con vật trong một câu chuyện được gọi là nhân vật.

flashcards.back_en: Not real, only in someone's imagination.
flashcards.example_en: Stories are not real; they are make-believe.
flashcards.example_vi: Truyện không có thật; đó là chuyện tưởng tượng.

flashcards.back_en: Facts that are true and that you can learn from.
flashcards.example_en: Some books give real information.
flashcards.example_vi: Có những quyển sách cho thông tin có thật.

flashcards.back_en: The name of a book or story.
flashcards.example_en: What is the title of the book?
flashcards.example_vi: Tên quyển sách này là gì?

flashcards.back_en: The writer of a book.
flashcards.example_en: Who is the author of the book?
flashcards.example_vi: Ai là tác giả của quyển sách?

flashcards.back_en: A box you carry your lunch in.
flashcards.example_en: She has a lunchbox in her backpack.
flashcards.example_vi: Bạn ấy có một hộp cơm trưa trong ba lô.

flashcards.back_en: A small book of empty pages for writing in.
flashcards.example_en: He has a notebook and a pencil.
flashcards.example_vi: Bạn ấy có một quyển vở và một cái bút chì.

flashcards.back_en: A rope you jump over again and again.
flashcards.example_en: There is a skipping rope in Jill's backpack.
flashcards.example_vi: Trong ba lô của Jill có một sợi dây nhảy.

flashcards.back_en: Dark glasses you wear when the sun is bright.
flashcards.example_en: He wears sunglasses on the field trip.
flashcards.example_vi: Bạn ấy đeo kính râm khi đi dã ngoại.

flashcards.back_en: A small thing you use to talk to someone far away.
flashcards.example_en: Her phone is in the yellow backpack.
flashcards.example_vi: Điện thoại của bạn ấy ở trong cái ba lô vàng.

flashcards.back_en: Something you wear on your head.
flashcards.example_en: He has a hat and two keys.
flashcards.example_vi: Bạn ấy có một cái mũ và hai chiếc chìa khoá.

flashcards.back_en: A warm top you pull over your head.
flashcards.example_en: She has a yellow jumper.
flashcards.example_vi: Bạn ấy có một chiếc áo len màu vàng.

flashcards.back_en: A small metal thing that opens a lock.
flashcards.example_en: He has two keys.
flashcards.example_vi: Bạn ấy có hai chiếc chìa khoá.

flashcards.back_en: A thin stick you write and draw with.
flashcards.example_en: There is a pencil in my lunchbox.
flashcards.example_vi: Có một cái bút chì trong hộp cơm của em.

flashcards.back_en: A round red or green fruit.
flashcards.example_en: Apple starts with the short a sound.
flashcards.example_vi: Từ apple bắt đầu bằng âm a ngắn.

flashcards.back_en: The round thing a bird lays, which we can eat.
flashcards.example_en: Egg starts with the short e sound.
flashcards.example_vi: Từ egg bắt đầu bằng âm e ngắn.

flashcards.back_en: A small animal with six legs, like an ant.
flashcards.example_en: Insect starts with the short i sound.
flashcards.example_vi: Từ insect bắt đầu bằng âm i ngắn.

flashcards.back_en: A sea animal with eight arms.
flashcards.example_en: Octopus starts with the short o sound.
flashcards.example_vi: Từ octopus bắt đầu bằng âm o ngắn.

flashcards.back_en: A thing you hold over your head in the rain.
flashcards.example_en: Umbrella starts with the short u sound.
flashcards.example_vi: Từ umbrella bắt đầu bằng âm u ngắn.

flashcards.back_en: A big boat that carries people across the sea.
flashcards.example_en: Ship begins with the sh sound.
flashcards.example_vi: Từ ship bắt đầu bằng âm sh.

flashcards.back_en: Long thin pieces of potato that are cooked in oil.
flashcards.example_en: Chips begins with the ch sound.
flashcards.example_vi: Từ chips bắt đầu bằng âm ch.

flashcards.back_en: The lesson where you work with numbers and shapes.
flashcards.example_en: Maths ends with the th sound.
flashcards.example_vi: Từ maths kết thúc bằng âm th.

flashcards.back_en: To take hold of something moving through the air.
flashcards.example_en: Catch ends with the tch letters.
flashcards.example_vi: Từ catch kết thúc bằng cụm chữ tch.

flashcards.back_en: A round thing you kick, throw or catch.
flashcards.example_en: He has a ball in his backpack.
flashcards.example_vi: Bạn ấy có một quả bóng trong ba lô.

flashcards.back_en: One of the five letters A, E, I, O and U.
flashcards.example_en: A, E, I, O and U are vowels.
flashcards.example_vi: A, E, I, O, U là các nguyên âm.

flashcards.back_en: Any letter that is not a vowel.
flashcards.example_en: Some letters are called consonants and some are called vowels.
flashcards.example_vi: Có những chữ cái gọi là phụ âm và có những chữ gọi là nguyên âm.

flashcards.back_en: A small furry animal many people keep at home.
flashcards.example_en: The cat has the short a sound in the middle.
flashcards.example_vi: Từ cat có âm a ngắn ở giữa.

flashcards.back_en: To open or divide something with scissors or a knife.
flashcards.example_en: Cut has the short u sound in the middle.
flashcards.example_vi: Từ cut có âm u ngắn ở giữa.

flashcards.back_en: A thin tool you write with, using ink.
flashcards.example_en: How do you spell it? P-e-n.
flashcards.example_vi: Từ đó đánh vần thế nào? P-e-n.

flashcards.back_en: A place where you buy things.
flashcards.example_en: Shop begins with the sh sound.
flashcards.example_vi: Từ shop bắt đầu bằng âm sh.

flashcards.back_en: A hard piece of stone.
flashcards.example_en: Rock has the short o sound in the middle.
flashcards.example_vi: Từ rock có âm o ngắn ở giữa.

flashcards.back_en: Coming after the fourth one.
flashcards.example_en: Fifth ends with the th sound.
flashcards.example_vi: Từ fifth kết thúc bằng âm th.

flashcards.back_en: A person who lives near you.
flashcards.example_en: There are neighbours helping neighbours in my neighbourhood.
flashcards.example_vi: Có những người hàng xóm giúp đỡ nhau trong khu phố của em.

flashcards.back_en: The streets around your home.
flashcards.example_en: Come and meet the people in my neighbourhood.
flashcards.example_vi: Hãy đến gặp những người trong khu phố của em.

flashcards.back_en: The child of your aunt or uncle.
flashcards.example_en: What is his cousin doing?
flashcards.example_vi: Anh họ của bạn ấy đang làm gì?

flashcards.back_en: Your father's father or your mother's father.
flashcards.example_en: His sister and grandpa are helping too.
flashcards.example_vi: Chị bạn ấy và ông cũng đang giúp.

flashcards.back_en: A person whose job is to keep people safe.
flashcards.example_en: What is the police officer doing?
flashcards.example_vi: Chú cảnh sát đang làm gì?

flashcards.back_en: A person whose job is to look after people who are ill.
flashcards.example_en: Who is the nurse helping?
flashcards.example_vi: Cô y tá đang giúp ai?

flashcards.back_en: A person whose job is to find out news and tell people about it.
flashcards.example_en: The reporter is writing about our street.
flashcards.example_vi: Cô phóng viên đang viết về con phố của chúng em.

flashcards.back_en: A person whose job is to drive a bus.
flashcards.example_en: The bus driver stops for the children.
flashcards.example_vi: Bác tài xế xe buýt dừng lại cho các bạn nhỏ.

flashcards.back_en: A person whose job is to clean windows.
flashcards.example_en: The window cleaner works high above the street.
flashcards.example_vi: Chú lau kính làm việc trên cao phía trên con phố.

flashcards.back_en: A person whose job is to put out fires.
flashcards.example_en: Firefighters have important jobs. They put out fires.
flashcards.example_vi: Lính cứu hoả có công việc quan trọng. Họ dập lửa.

flashcards.back_en: To save someone from danger.
flashcards.example_en: They rescue people who are inside burning buildings.
flashcards.example_vi: Họ cứu những người đang ở trong toà nhà cháy.

flashcards.back_en: A hard hat that protects your head.
flashcards.example_en: If something falls on a firefighter's head, the helmet keeps them safe.
flashcards.example_vi: Nếu có vật rơi trúng đầu, chiếc mũ bảo hộ giữ cho lính cứu hoả an toàn.

flashcards.back_en: A cover for your face.
flashcards.example_en: The mask lets the firefighter breathe fresh air.
flashcards.example_vi: Chiếc mặt nạ giúp lính cứu hoả thở được không khí sạch.

flashcards.back_en: Covers for your hands.
flashcards.example_en: Firefighters can touch hot things with their gloves.
flashcards.example_vi: Nhờ găng tay, lính cứu hoả có thể chạm vào vật nóng.

flashcards.back_en: Strong shoes that cover your feet and ankles.
flashcards.example_en: They wear heavy boots on their feet.
flashcards.example_vi: Họ đi ủng nặng ở chân.

flashcards.back_en: To ask someone questions to find out about them.
flashcards.example_en: Josef is interviewing a firefighter.
flashcards.example_vi: Josef đang phỏng vấn một lính cứu hoả.

flashcards.back_en: A piece of writing that tells people what you found out.
flashcards.example_en: Josef writes a report about Miss Dilov and her job.
flashcards.example_vi: Josef viết một bài tường thuật về cô Dilov và công việc của cô.

flashcards.back_en: The building where firefighters work.
flashcards.example_en: She works at the fire station.
flashcards.example_vi: Cô ấy làm việc ở trạm cứu hoả.

flashcards.back_en: A home inside a bigger building.
flashcards.example_en: I live in an apartment building.
flashcards.example_vi: Em sống trong một toà chung cư.

flashcards.back_en: One level of a building.
flashcards.example_en: My family lives on the second floor.
flashcards.example_vi: Gia đình em sống ở tầng hai.

flashcards.back_en: A very big town.
flashcards.example_en: I live in Mexico, in a city called Merida.
flashcards.example_vi: Em sống ở Mexico, trong một thành phố tên là Merida.

flashcards.back_en: The most important city of a country.
flashcards.example_en: Mexico City is the capital of Mexico.
flashcards.example_vi: Mexico City là thủ đô của Mexico.

flashcards.back_en: One of the very large areas of land on Earth.
flashcards.example_en: Mexico is in North America. North America is a continent.
flashcards.example_vi: Mexico nằm ở Bắc Mỹ. Bắc Mỹ là một châu lục.

flashcards.back_en: A small room that carries you up and down a tall building.
flashcards.example_en: Silvia likes pressing the buttons in the lift.
flashcards.example_vi: Silvia thích bấm nút trong thang máy.

flashcards.back_en: A message you write and send to someone.
flashcards.example_en: This is a letter from Silvia.
flashcards.example_vi: Đây là một lá thư của Silvia.

flashcards.back_en: At the side of something.
flashcards.example_en: It's next to the shoe shop.
flashcards.example_vi: Nó ở ngay cạnh cửa hàng giày.

flashcards.back_en: With one thing on each side.
flashcards.example_en: It's between the bookshop and the sweet shop.
flashcards.example_vi: Nó nằm giữa hiệu sách và cửa hàng kẹo.

flashcards.back_en: On the other side, facing something.
flashcards.example_en: It's opposite the gift shop.
flashcards.example_vi: Nó ở đối diện cửa hàng quà tặng.

flashcards.back_en: At the back of something.
flashcards.example_en: Look behind the door.
flashcards.example_vi: Hãy nhìn phía sau cánh cửa.

flashcards.back_en: At the front of something.
flashcards.example_en: Look in front of the crayons.
flashcards.example_vi: Hãy nhìn phía trước hộp bút màu.

flashcards.back_en: Below something.
flashcards.example_en: Look under the teacher's chair.
flashcards.example_vi: Hãy nhìn dưới ghế của cô giáo.

flashcards.back_en: Forwards, without turning.
flashcards.example_en: Put your finger on the red star and go straight ahead.
flashcards.example_vi: Đặt ngón tay lên ngôi sao đỏ rồi đi thẳng.

flashcards.back_en: To go to the right side.
flashcards.example_en: At the end, turn right.
flashcards.example_vi: Đến cuối đường thì rẽ phải.

flashcards.back_en: A big building with many shops inside.
flashcards.example_en: Look at the map of the shopping centre.
flashcards.example_vi: Hãy nhìn bản đồ trung tâm mua sắm.

flashcards.back_en: A person who sings.
flashcards.example_en: I'm a singer. I sing.
flashcards.example_vi: Em là ca sĩ. Em hát.

flashcards.back_en: A person who teaches.
flashcards.example_en: I'm a teacher. I teach.
flashcards.example_vi: Em là giáo viên. Em dạy học.

flashcards.back_en: A person who acts in plays and films.
flashcards.example_en: I'm an actor. I act.
flashcards.example_vi: Em là diễn viên. Em diễn.

flashcards.back_en: A person who writes books.
flashcards.example_en: I am a writer. I write books.
flashcards.example_vi: Em là nhà văn. Em viết sách.

flashcards.back_en: A person who works on a boat.
flashcards.example_en: I am a sailor. I sail boats.
flashcards.example_vi: Em là thuỷ thủ. Em lái thuyền.

flashcards.back_en: A person who paints.
flashcards.example_en: I am a painter. I paint pictures.
flashcards.example_vi: Em là hoạ sĩ. Em vẽ tranh.

flashcards.back_en: A person who bakes bread.
flashcards.example_en: I am a baker. I bake bread.
flashcards.example_vi: Em là thợ làm bánh. Em nướng bánh mì.

flashcards.back_en: A person who watches birds.
flashcards.example_en: I am a birdwatcher. I like to watch birds.
flashcards.example_vi: Em là người ngắm chim. Em thích ngắm chim.

flashcards.back_en: Many; a big number of.
flashcards.example_en: There are a lot of kids living in my apartment building.
flashcards.example_vi: Có rất nhiều bạn nhỏ sống trong toà chung cư của em.

flashcards.back_en: A road in a town with houses along it.
flashcards.example_en: There are a lot of apartment buildings on my street.
flashcards.example_vi: Có rất nhiều toà chung cư trên phố nhà em.

flashcards.back_en: A land with its own name and government.
flashcards.example_en: And cities in this country, and a lot of countries in the world.
flashcards.example_vi: Và các thành phố trong đất nước này, và rất nhiều đất nước trên thế giới.

flashcards.back_en: The Earth and everyone on it.
flashcards.example_en: We've got the whole world in our hands.
flashcards.example_vi: Chúng ta có cả thế giới trong tay mình.

flashcards.back_en: To think about something you are not sure of.
flashcards.example_en: I wonder if somewhere there's a kid I've never met.
flashcards.example_vi: Em tự hỏi liệu ở đâu đó có một bạn nhỏ em chưa từng gặp.

flashcards.back_en: Not known to you.
flashcards.example_en: Dear unknown friend, my name is Silvia.
flashcards.example_vi: Gửi người bạn chưa quen, mình tên là Silvia.

flashcards.back_en: Not friendly.
flashcards.example_en: Do you think the girl is friendly or unfriendly?
flashcards.example_vi: Em nghĩ bạn nữ ấy thân thiện hay không thân thiện?

flashcards.back_en: Not happy; sad.
flashcards.example_en: Do you think this poem is happy or unhappy?
flashcards.example_vi: Em nghĩ bài thơ này vui hay buồn?

quiz.stem_en: Choose the right words: ___ one ruler on my table.
quiz.why_en: One ruler is a single thing, so you use There is (p.15).

quiz.stem_en: Choose the right words: ___ three jackets on the chair.
quiz.why_en: Three jackets is more than one, so you use There are (p.15).

quiz.stem_en: Which question asks about the number of chairs?
quiz.why_en: How many asks about number (p.15).

quiz.stem_en: Which classroom object shows the days and months of the year?
quiz.why_en: A calendar is a chart that shows the days and months (p.14).

quiz.stem_en: You want to find your country. Which classroom object do you look at?
quiz.why_en: A map is a drawing that shows where places are (p.14).

quiz.stem_en: Choose the right word: The children ___ every morning.
quiz.why_en: The children means they, so the verb takes no -s (p.16).

quiz.stem_en: Choose the right word: Marco ___ a book on Tuesday.
quiz.why_en: Marco is he, so the verb takes -s (p.16).

quiz.stem_en: When does a present simple verb take an extra -s?

choices.en: When the subject is I or you
When the subject is he, she or it
When the subject is we or they

quiz.why_en: The children sing, but Marco sings: he, she and it take -s (p.16).

quiz.stem_en: Which day comes straight after Monday?
quiz.why_en: Tuesday is the day after Monday (p.16).

quiz.stem_en: What are the people or animals in a story called?
quiz.why_en: The people or animals in a story are called characters (p.17).

quiz.stem_en: A book tells about a talking snowman who goes to the moon. What kind of book is it?
quiz.why_en: Stories are not real; they are make-believe (p.17).

quiz.stem_en: What is the title of a book?

choices.en: The last page of the book

quiz.why_en: The title is the name of a book or story (p.18).

quiz.stem_en: Who is the author of a book?
quiz.why_en: The author is the writer (p.18).

quiz.stem_en: Where is the contents page, and what does it do?

choices.en: At the end, and it tells you who wrote the book
At the beginning, and it tells you what is in the book
In the middle, and it shows the pictures
On the cover, and it gives the title

quiz.why_en: A contents page is at the beginning of a book and tells you what is in it (p.18).

quiz.stem_en: A contents page reads: 1 School uniforms 2, 2 First day of school 6, 3 Art class 10, 4 Lunchtime 14. Which page do you turn to for art class?
quiz.why_en: The contents page shows chapter 3, Art class, starting on page 10 (p.18).

quiz.stem_en: What is one chapter of a book?

choices.en: One part of the book, with its own name

quiz.why_en: There are four chapters in the book, and each has its own title (p.18).

quiz.stem_en: Choose the right words: This backpack belongs to Lucy. It is ___ backpack.
quiz.why_en: Add 's to the owner's name: Lucy's backpack is red (p.20).

quiz.stem_en: Say this in a shorter way: Yes, it's my backpack.
quiz.why_en: Mine replaces my backpack (p.20).

quiz.stem_en: Say this in a shorter way: Is this your backpack?
quiz.why_en: Yours replaces your backpack (p.20).

quiz.stem_en: Your friend says 'The red one.' What does the word one mean here?

choices.en: The thing you are both talking about
The first child in the line

quiz.why_en: The red backpack becomes the red one, because you both know what you mean (p.20).

quiz.stem_en: Which thing in a backpack do you carry your lunch in?
quiz.why_en: A lunchbox is a box you carry your lunch in (p.21).

quiz.stem_en: It is cold in the classroom. Which of these do you put on?
quiz.why_en: A jumper is a warm top you pull over your head (p.21).

quiz.stem_en: Which five letters are the vowels?
quiz.why_en: A, E, I, O and U are vowels; the other letters are consonants (p.22).

quiz.stem_en: Which word starts with the short u sound?
quiz.why_en: Umbrella starts with the short u sound (p.22).

quiz.stem_en: Which word starts with the short o sound?
quiz.why_en: Octopus starts with the short o sound (p.22).

quiz.stem_en: Which word begins with the sh sound?
quiz.why_en: Ship begins with the sh sound (p.23).

quiz.stem_en: Which two words end with the same sound?
quiz.why_en: Maths and fifth both end with the th sound (p.23).

quiz.stem_en: Your partner points at a picture and asks, 'How do you spell it?' What do you do?

choices.en: Say the letters of the word one by one
Say the word in your home language
Count how many pictures there are

quiz.why_en: You answer by saying the letters, such as p-e-n (p.23).

quiz.stem_en: Fernando writes his book by himself. Which words does he use?
quiz.why_en: Fernando wrote his book by himself, so he uses I and my (p.27).

quiz.stem_en: Your class writes a chapter together. Choose the right sentence.

choices.en: Our teacher's name is Ms Cruz.
My teacher's name is Ms Cruz.
I teacher's name is Ms Cruz.
Their teacher's name is Ms Cruz.

quiz.why_en: A group writing together uses we and our (p.27).

quiz.stem_en: In science class the children use batteries and wires. What do they make happen?

choices.en: They make a light bulb turn on
They make a picture for the wall

quiz.why_en: We use batteries and wires to make a light bulb turn on (p.25).

quiz.stem_en: How long is break time at Fernando's school?
quiz.why_en: I have 15 minutes for break time (p.25).

quiz.stem_en: A child puts the science materials away carefully and remembers her homework. What does this show?
quiz.why_en: Using materials safely and remembering your homework are ways of being responsible (p.26).

quiz.stem_en: What is your neighbourhood?

choices.en: The country you were born in

quiz.why_en: A neighbourhood is the streets around your home (p.31).

quiz.stem_en: Whose job is it to look after people who are ill?
quiz.why_en: A nurse looks after people who are ill (p.31).

quiz.stem_en: Whose job is it to find out news and tell people about it?
quiz.why_en: A reporter finds out news and tells people about it (p.31).

quiz.stem_en: Your aunt's son is what to you?
quiz.why_en: A cousin is the child of your aunt or uncle (p.30).

quiz.stem_en: Which question word do you use to ask about a person?
quiz.why_en: Who is the nurse helping? asks about a person (p.31).

quiz.stem_en: Which question would you ask to find out an action?

choices.en: What is the police officer doing?
Where is the police officer from?

quiz.why_en: What? asks about the action (p.31).

quiz.stem_en: A poem says there are neighbours helping neighbours. What is it about?

choices.en: The people who live near each other

quiz.why_en: The poem My neighbourhood is about the people on the streets around home (p.31).

quiz.stem_en: What is a firefighter's job?

choices.en: To put out fires and rescue people

quiz.why_en: Firefighters put out fires and rescue people from burning buildings (p.32).

quiz.stem_en: Something falls on a firefighter's head. Which piece of kit keeps them safe?
quiz.why_en: If something falls on a firefighter's head, the helmet keeps them safe (p.32).

quiz.stem_en: Why does a firefighter wear a mask and an air pack?
quiz.why_en: The mask lets the firefighter breathe fresh air (p.32).

quiz.stem_en: Why do firefighters wear heavy gloves?

choices.en: So they can touch hot things

quiz.why_en: They can touch hot things with their gloves (p.32).

quiz.stem_en: Firefighters' jackets are made from special material. What is special about it?
quiz.why_en: They wear heavy jackets made from materials that do not burn (p.32).

quiz.stem_en: Josef asks a firefighter questions to find out about her job. What is he doing?
quiz.why_en: To interview is to ask someone questions to find out about them (p.33).

quiz.stem_en: Josef writes down what he found out about Miss Dilov's job. What is that piece of writing called?
quiz.why_en: A report tells people what you found out (p.33).

quiz.stem_en: Silvia's family lives on the second floor. What does floor mean here?
quiz.why_en: A floor is one level of a building (p.34).

quiz.stem_en: What is the capital of a country?
quiz.why_en: The capital is the most important city of a country (p.34).

quiz.stem_en: Mexico is in North America. What is North America?
quiz.why_en: North America is a continent (p.35).

quiz.stem_en: You want to reach the fourteenth floor of a tall building. What do you use?
quiz.why_en: A lift carries you up and down a tall building (p.35).

quiz.stem_en: On the map, Merida is in square D-2. What does a map show you?
quiz.why_en: A map is a drawing that shows where places are (p.34).

quiz.stem_en: A shop has the bookshop on one side and the sweet shop on the other. Where is it?
quiz.why_en: Between means with one thing on each side (p.36).

quiz.stem_en: A shop is on the other side of the walkway, facing the gift shop. Which word says that?
quiz.why_en: Opposite means on the other side, facing something (p.36).

quiz.stem_en: A clue says to look at the back of the door. Which word means that?
quiz.why_en: Behind means at the back of something (p.37).

quiz.stem_en: A clue says to look below the teacher's chair. Which word means that?
quiz.why_en: Under means below something (p.37).

quiz.stem_en: You are following a map and must go forwards without turning. What do you say?
quiz.why_en: Straight ahead means forwards, without turning (p.36).

quiz.stem_en: How do you politely start asking a stranger for directions?

choices.en: You tell me the gift shop.
Excuse me, where is the gift shop?

quiz.why_en: Excuse me makes the question polite (p.36).

quiz.stem_en: You add -er to the verb sing. What word do you get?
quiz.why_en: sing + er = singer (p.38).

quiz.stem_en: You add -or to the verb act. What word do you get?
quiz.why_en: act + or = actor (p.38).

quiz.stem_en: What do the spellings -er, -ir, -or and -ur have in common?

choices.en: They are all said as separate letters
They can all stand for the same sound
They are all used only for jobs

quiz.why_en: The spellings -er, -ir, -or and -ur can all stand for the same sound (p.39).

quiz.stem_en: A person who bakes bread is called what?
quiz.why_en: Add -er to bake: baker (p.38).

quiz.stem_en: Which of these words has the -ur spelling of that sound?
quiz.why_en: Nurse is spelled with -ur (p.39).

quiz.stem_en: In the poem, what does the phrase a lot of mean?
quiz.why_en: A lot of means many (p.40).

quiz.stem_en: The poem starts with kids in one building and ends with countries in the world. What does it show?

choices.en: That kids never meet each other
That the world holds a great many kids
That only one kid lives on the street

quiz.why_en: The poem widens out from one building to the whole world (p.40-41).

quiz.stem_en: What does the prefix un- do to a word?

choices.en: It makes the word mean the opposite
It makes the word mean more
It makes the word a question

quiz.why_en: helpful becomes unhelpful when you add un- (p.42).

quiz.stem_en: Which word beginning with un- means sad?
quiz.why_en: Unhappy is another word for sad (p.42).

quiz.stem_en: Silvia writes to someone she has never met. How does she begin her letter?
quiz.why_en: She writes Dear unknown friend (p.34, p.42).

quiz.stem_en: At the end of the poem, what does the girl wonder?

choices.en: Whether her building is the tallest
Whether she will move to a new city
Whether a kid she has never met might become her best friend

quiz.why_en: She wonders if that kid and she might be best friends if they ever met (p.41).

quiz.stem_en: Silvia lives on floor number two. Which word gives that as a position?
quiz.why_en: Ordinal numbers such as first, second and third give the position (p.35).
